How we'll work together

Simple, transparent, no surprises.

1

Brief

You tell me about your business, your style pick and the pages you need. Short call or chat — your choice.

2

First draft

I design the homepage direction first, so you can react to something real before the whole site is built.

3

Build & revise

I build the full site and we revise together until it looks right on phone, tablet and desktop.

4

Launch

Your site goes live, and I show you how to update text and images yourself — no designer needed for small changes.
